source.title: Reliability without Validity: A Systematic, Large-Scale Evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge Models Across Agreement, Consistency, and Bias

extracted_protocol.name: Minimum Viable Validation Protocol (MVVP)
steps: Chance-correct: report Cohen's kappa or Krippendorff's alpha alongside exact match and make the chance-corrected metric the headline reliability number.
Swap positions: paired AB+BA evaluations; report absolute position bias |P(A wins)-0.5|.
Replicate: >=3 independent runs at temperature 0 with response caching disabled; measure test-retest reliability.
Cross-validate: >=2 benchmarks spanning preference-style and correctness-style label distributions.
Audit the consistency-bias paradox: when test-retest >0.95, verify position bias <0.10 before claiming reliability.

metric_definitions.position_flip_rate: fraction of items whose verdict changes under AB<->BA swap
metric_definitions.test_retest: agreement of a judge with itself across independent reevaluations of the same items

quantitative_support: Across 21 judges on MT-Bench, kappa deflation ranged 33.8-41.3 percentage points; cohort mean 38.6 pp.
Gemini 3.1 Pro: MT-Bench exact match 0.849 vs kappa 0.511, a 33.8 pp deflation.
JudgeBench's judge spread was 60.4 pp in kappa versus 13.5 pp on MT-Bench, about 4.5x wider, motivating multi-benchmark validation.
Qwen 3 8B: test-retest 0.992, position bias 0.192, JudgeBench kappa 0.289; empirical example of high consistency with poor validity.
Gemini 2.5 Flash: test-retest 0.988, position bias 0.125; same paradox more mildly.

threshold_assessment.three_or_more_replicates: Protocol recommendation based on study design; not presented as a formal power-optimal sample size.
threshold_assessment.test_retest_0_95_and_position_bias_0_10: Operational failure thresholds motivated by the study's a-priori hypothesis and observed paradox; should be treated as heuristic deployment gates, not universal statistical constants.
threshold_assessment.two_benchmarks: Minimum diversity recommendation motivated by large rank instability across preference-vs-correctness benchmarks; not a guarantee of construct coverage.

new_candidate_refinement.refinement: Operationalize the candidate as a five-gate MVVP rather than a loose metric bundle. Preserve the distinction between agreement, repeatability, invariance, and cross-construct validity.
new_candidate_refinement.important_caveat: The source explicitly defers probability calibration (ECE/Brier) because many providers do not expose token logprobs; calibration must be added as a separate axis when available.

frontier_queue.question: Trace ICLR 2026 certified/conformal evaluation methods that model judge TPR/FPR and give finite-sample error guarantees; determine whether they can supply principled thresholds/sample sizes missing from MVVP.
Derive a power/sample-size procedure for position-bias and test-retest gates rather than using fixed >=3 replicate and 0.10 bias thresholds.
Test whether chance-corrected metrics remain stable under benchmark label-marginal shifts and whether prevalence-adjusted alternatives outperform kappa for strongly imbalanced judge datasets.
Combine MVVP with calibrated judge uncertainty/ECE-Brier and selective abstention when provider logprobs or repeated-sampling confidence are available.

termination_diagnostics.status: continued beyond first checkpoint; not complete
termination_diagnostics.completed_unresolved_action: Extracted the full MVVP, its exact gates, metric definitions, quantitative support, and identified which thresholds are heuristic rather than formally justified.
termination_diagnostics.exact_next_action: Search primary ICLR 2026/open-access sources for certified LLM evaluation with judge TPR/FPR or conformal finite-sample error control, then compare its assumptions and guarantees against MVVP.
